used_by.target_markdown: ![Three mean-zero, unit-variance skew-normal return-density panels compare positive, zero, and negative skew; each panel shades its characteristic tail and marks its model median.](../../img/generated/risk-skewness-tail-orientation.png)

assets.prompt: Do not generate this image with an image model. Render an exact 1920x1080 PNG with `uv run python scripts/generate_module7_risk_diagrams.py --asset risk-skewness-tail-orientation`. Use separate positive-skew, zero-skew, and negative-skew panels; standardize every skew-normal model to mean zero and variance one, calculate each median from the plotted distribution, and shade the relevant tail direction.
production_notes: Original deterministic figure authored in this repository for the book; no external image or third-party data are incorporated.
Every skew-normal model is analytically transformed to mean zero and variance one before its density, quantiles, and median are drawn.
All dashed median markers are calculated with the same standardized skew-normal distributions used to draw the densities.
Separate panels, direct labels, hatching, and line style preserve meaning without relying on color alone.
